questions.stem: According to the passage, what was Luna 9 the first spacecraft to do?
options: Carry out a soft landing on the moon
Land humans on the lunar surface
Return moon rock samples to Earth
Explore the far side of the moon
questions.evidence: NASA says Luna 9 was the first spacecraft to carry out a soft landing on the moon.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에서 NASA는 Luna 9가 달에 처음으로 연착륙한 우주선이라고 명시하고 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT true about China's moon missions?
options: China landed the Yutu rover in 2013
China landed the Yutu-2 rover on the moon's far side in 2019
China returned lunar samples to Earth in 2020 and 2024
China aims to land astronauts on the moon by 2020
questions.evidence: China has said it aims to land its astronauts on the moon by 2030.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에 따르면 중국은 2030년까지 우주비행사를 달에 보내는 것을 목표로 하고 있으며, 2020년이 아닙니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that Russia's 2023 Luna 25 mission crash landed, while its 1976 Luna 24 mission landed successfully?
options: Russia had not attempted a moon landing in nearly 50 years and may have lost some technical expertise
Russia deliberately crashed the spacecraft to save money
Russia's space program has never had a successful moon landing
Russia was attempting to land humans on the moon in 2023
questions.evidence: The country’s last effort before that, Luna 24 in 1976, landed successfully and returned moon rocks to Earth.
questions.explanation_ko: 거의 50년 만의 시도였다는 점과 이전 성공 사례를 비교하면, 그 사이 기술이나 경험이 부족해졌을 가능성을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that Surveyor 1 was described as "the first of a series of seven robotic spacecraft sent to the moon to gather data in preparation for NASA's Apollo missions"?
options: To show how earlier robotic missions helped prepare for later human moon landings
To argue that Surveyor 1 was more important than Luna 9
To explain why the Soviet Union stopped sending spacecraft to the moon
To describe the technical problems Surveyor 1 experienced
questions.evidence: NASA describes this effort as “the first of a series of seven robotic spacecraft sent to the moon to gather data in preparation for NASA's Apollo missions.”
questions.explanation_ko: 이 문장은 Surveyor 임무가 이후 아폴로 유인 달 착륙을 준비하기 위한 자료 수집 과정이었음을 보여주기 위해 언급되었습니다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "It touched down on the lunar surface in 1966," what does "touched down" mean?
options: Landed
Crashed and was destroyed
Was launched
Sent a signal
questions.evidence: It touched down on the lunar surface in 1966.

blanks.sentence_ko: NASA는 Luna 9가 달에 연착륙을 수행한 첫 우주선이라고 말한다.
하지만 그것은 달 표면에 충돌 착륙한 것으로 여겨진다.
중국은 2019년 달의 미탐사된 뒷면에 착륙한 Yutu-2 로버로 뒤를 이었다.
아폴로 임무를 준비하기 위해 자료를 수집하기 위해 보내진 일곱 대의 로봇 우주선 중 첫 번째였다.

key_points: The Soviet Union's Luna 9 was the first spacecraft to soft-land on the moon in 1966.
The United States followed with Surveyor 1 in 1966, preparing for the Apollo program.
In 1969, the U.S. Apollo 11 mission landed the first humans on the moon, and the U.S. remains the only country to do so.
China became the third country to land on the moon in 2013 and later returned lunar samples and landed on the moon's far side.
Russia's 2023 Luna 25 mission crash landed, its first attempt in nearly 50 years.
India (2023) and Japan (2024) became the fourth and fifth countries to successfully land spacecraft on the moon.
main_idea: The passage traces the history of spacecraft moon landings from the Soviet Union's first soft landing in 1966 through recent missions by the U.S., China, Russia, India, and Japan.
restate_sentence: Luna 9’s landing proved “the lunar surface could support the weight of a lander and that an object would not sink into a loose layer of dust as some models predicted,” NASA said.
